name: clean-code
description: Robert C. Martin's Clean Code as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for naming, small functions, comments, error handling, tests, concurrency and scoped cleanup of touched code.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Clean Code rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
